translations.literal: Once ranks were formed, the gates closed, horns sounded, a shout went up, and they advanced with clamor.
translations.idiomatic: Once ranks were formed, the gates closed, horns sounded, and with shouts and clamor they advanced.

sentences.zh: 兩翼隊皆雁綴進，鳴金收軍。

translations.literal: Both wing companies advanced in goose-formation; gongs sounded to recall the troops.
translations.idiomatic: Both wing companies advanced in goose formation; gongs sounded to recall the troops.

sentences.zh: 立本陣，結隊徐旋，首隊殿。

translations.literal: They stood in their original formation, formed ranks and slowly wheeled about, the first company bringing up the rear.
translations.idiomatic: They returned to their original formation, formed ranks and slowly wheeled about, with the first company bringing up the rear.

sentences.zh: 罷閱，還行宮，申敕明賞罰。

translations.literal: The review ended; returning to the traveling palace, he issued edicts clarifying rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: The review ended; returning to the traveling palace, he issued edicts clarifying rewards and punishments.

sentences.zh: 未閱前，賜軍士食，既閱，賜酒。

translations.literal: Before the review, food was granted to the soldiers; after the review, wine was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Before the review, food was granted to the soldiers; after the review, wine was granted.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，世宗幸南苑，閱車騎營兵，諭曰：「此第訓練一端耳，遇敵決勝，在相機度勢，神而明之，存乎其人，豈區區陣伍間遂足以制敵耶？」

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongzheng, the Shizong visited the Southern Park and reviewed the Chariot and Cavalry camp troops. He instructed: "This is but one aspect of training. When meeting the enemy and deciding victory, it lies in sizing up circumstances and gauging the situation—applying it with insight and clarity depends upon the man. How could mere array and formation alone suffice to subdue the enemy?"
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yongzheng, the Shizong visited the Southern Park and reviewed the Chariot and Cavalry camp troops. He instructed: "This is but one aspect of training. When meeting the enemy and deciding victory, it lies in sizing up circumstances and gauging the situation—applying it with insight and clarity depends upon the man. How could mere array and formation alone suffice to subdue the enemy?"

sentences.zh: 是日操演，各依方位、旗色為陣式。

translations.literal: That day in the drill performance, each unit arranged its formation according to position and banner color.
translations.idiomatic: That day in the drill performance, each unit arranged its formation according to position and banner color.

sentences.zh: 後北征，屢以車戰勝。

translations.literal: Later in the northern campaigns, they repeatedly won through chariot warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Later, in the northern campaigns, they repeatedly won through chariot warfare.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，大閱，幸南苑，御帳殿。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong, a grand review was held; he visited the Southern Park and took his seat in the canopy hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qianlong, a grand review was held; he visited the Southern Park and took his seat in the canopy hall.

sentences.zh: 軍隊既齊，步軍整列進。

translations.literal: Once the armies were assembled, the infantry formed ranks and advanced in order.
translations.idiomatic: Once the armies were assembled, the infantry formed ranks and advanced in order.

sentences.zh: 以十丈為率，餘儀同。

translations.literal: Taking ten zhang as the standard measure, the rest of the ceremony followed the same pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Taking ten zhang as the standard measure, the rest of the ceremony followed the same pattern.

sentences.zh: 令甲，大閱日，行宮外陳鹵簿，駕出，作鐃歌大樂，奏壯軍容章。

translations.literal: By regulation, on the day of the grand review, the imperial retinue was displayed outside the traveling palace. When the imperial procession set out, the great music of the naoge was performed and the "Zhuang Junrong" anthem was played.
translations.idiomatic: By regulation, on the day of the grand review, the imperial retinue was displayed outside the traveling palace. When the imperial procession set out, the great naoge music was performed and the "Zhuang Junrong" anthem was played.

sentences.zh: 及還，作清樂，奏鬯皇威章。

translations.literal: Upon returning, clear music was performed and the "Chang Huangwei" anthem was played.
translations.idiomatic: Upon returning, clear music was performed and the "Chang Huangwei" anthem was played.

sentences.zh: 凡操時鳴砲三，駕出及還同。

translations.literal: Whenever drills were held, three cannon shots sounded; the same when setting out and returning.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever drills were held, three cannon shots sounded—the same when setting out and when returning.

sentences.zh: 即日賜各旗饌筵、羊豕、薪炭。

translations.literal: That same day, each banner was granted feast provisions, sheep and pigs, firewood and charcoal.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, each banner was granted feast provisions, sheep and pigs, firewood and charcoal.

sentences.zh: 迄嘉慶間，皆如故事行。

translations.literal: Down through the Jiaqing period, all was conducted according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Down through the Jiaqing period, all was conducted according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 會閱為康熙三十年創典，時喀爾喀新附，聖祖思訓以法度，特命會閱上都七溪，乃集其部眾，並四十九旗籓王、台吉，豫屯百里外。

translations.literal: Joint review was an institution newly created in the thirtieth year of Kangxi. At that time the Khalkha had newly submitted; the Shenzu wished to instruct them in law and regulation and specially ordered a joint review at Qixi on the Upper Capital grounds, gathering their tribesmen together along with the banner princes and taishi of the forty-nine banners, who were beforehand encamped a hundred li away.
translations.idiomatic: Joint review was an institution newly created in the thirtieth year of Kangxi. At that time the Khalkha had newly submitted; the Shenzu wished to instruct them in law and regulation and specially ordered a joint review at Qixi on the Upper Capital grounds, gathering their tribesmen together with the banner princes and taishi of the forty-nine banners, who were encamped a hundred li away in advance.

sentences.zh: 駕出都，上三旗兵從，下五旗兵自獨石來會。

translations.literal: The imperial procession left the capital; troops of the Upper Three Banners followed, while troops of the Lower Five Banners came from Dushi to join.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial procession left the capital; troops of the Upper Three Banners followed, while troops of the Lower Five Banners came from Dushi to join.

sentences.zh: 布營設哨，三旗護軍為一營，居中。

translations.literal: Camps were laid out and sentry posts established; the guard troops of three banners formed one camp, stationed in the center.
translations.idiomatic: Camps were laid out and sentry posts established; guard troops of three banners formed one camp, stationed in the center.

sentences.zh: 八旗前鋒為二營，五旗護軍為十營，火器營兵為四營，環御營而屯。

translations.literal: Vanguard troops of the Eight Banners formed two camps; guard troops of five banners formed ten camps; firearms camp soldiers formed four camps—all encamped surrounding the imperial camp.
translations.idiomatic: Vanguard troops of the Eight Banners formed two camps; guard troops of five banners formed ten camps; firearms camp soldiers formed four camps—all encamped surrounding the imperial camp.

sentences.zh: 前鋒為四哨，護軍為二十四哨，各設廬帳，繞營而居。

translations.literal: Vanguard troops formed four outposts; guard troops formed twenty-four outposts; each set up tents and dwelled around the camps.
translations.idiomatic: Vanguard troops formed four outposts and guard troops formed twenty-four outposts; each set up tents and encamped around the camps.

sentences.zh: 蒙古、喀爾喀諸屯徙近五十里，禁入哨。

translations.literal: Mongol and Khalkha encampments were moved to within about fifty li; entry into the outposts was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol and Khalkha encampments were moved to within about fifty li, and entry into the outposts was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 釐賞九等，序坐七列。

translations.literal: Rewards were graded in nine ranks; seating was ordered in seven rows.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards were graded in nine ranks, and seating was ordered in seven rows.

sentences.zh: 網城設宸幄，正中御床，左右行帳各二，儀仗、樂懸具。

translations.literal: Within the net enclosure an imperial canopy was set up, with the imperial couch in the center; on left and right, two traveling tents each; regalia and suspended musical instruments all in place.
translations.idiomatic: Within the net enclosure an imperial canopy was set up, with the imperial couch in the center; on left and right were two traveling tents each, with regalia and suspended musical instruments all in place.

sentences.zh: 依次置宴。

translations.literal: Banquets were set in order.
translations.idiomatic: Banquets were set in order.

sentences.zh: 蒙古王等居左，喀爾喀居右，順序習舞，眾技畢陳。

translations.literal: Mongol princes and others sat on the left; Khalkha on the right. Dances were performed in turn and all feats of skill were displayed.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol princes and others sat on the left and Khalkha on the right; dances were performed in turn and all feats of skill were displayed.

sentences.zh: 乃命喀爾喀汗、濟農、諾顏等進御前，賜卮酒，餘令侍衛分送。

translations.literal: Then he ordered Khalkha khans, jinong, noyan, and others to approach before the emperor; goblets of wine were granted, and the rest were directed to have bodyguards distribute them.
translations.idiomatic: Then he ordered Khalkha khans, jinong, noyan, and others to approach before the emperor; goblets of wine were granted, and the rest were sent by bodyguards to distribute.

sentences.zh: 禮成。

translations.literal: The rites were completed.
translations.idiomatic: The rites were completed.

sentences.zh: 翼日各營就列，陳巨砲，帝擐甲，閱畢宣敕，去其汗號，以王、貝勒、貝子、公名爵分錫之。

translations.literal: The next day each camp took its position; great cannon were deployed; the emperor donned armor, and when the review was finished issued an edict removing their khan titles and distributing titles of prince, beile, beizi, and duke according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: The next day each camp took its position and great cannon were deployed; the emperor donned armor, and when the review was finished issued an edict removing their khan titles and distributing titles of prince, beile, beizi, and duke according to rank.

sentences.zh: 台吉分四等，比四十九旗，依等賜賚，恩禮有加，餘如儀。

translations.literal: Taishi were divided into four grades; compared with the forty-nine banners, rewards were granted according to rank, with added favor and ceremony; the rest followed protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Taishi were divided into four grades; compared with the forty-nine banners, rewards were granted according to rank with added favor and ceremony; the rest followed protocol.

sentences.zh: 京營訓練，歲以春、秋季月合操四次，春貫甲，秋常服，營陣規制如大閱。

translations.literal: Capital garrison training: each year in the second month of spring and autumn, joint drills were held four times; in spring full armor was worn, in autumn regular dress; camp formation regulations followed the grand review.
translations.idiomatic: Capital garrison training: each year in the second month of spring and autumn, joint drills were held four times; in spring full armor was worn and in autumn regular dress, with camp formation regulations following the grand review.

sentences.zh: 仲春、孟秋則按旗登城習鳴螺。

translations.literal: In mid-spring and early autumn, each banner in turn ascended the city wall to practice blowing conch horns.
translations.idiomatic: In mid-spring and early autumn, each banner in turn ascended the city wall to practice blowing conch horns.

sentences.zh: 兵部遣官稽閱，歲為常制。

translations.literal: The Board of War dispatched officials to inspect and verify; this was the annual regular institution.
translations.idiomatic: The Board of War dispatched officials to inspect and verify; this was the annual regular institution.

sentences.zh: 護軍驍騎營一歲三校騎射，前鋒護軍營三歲一較騎射，內大臣、本旗都統等臨視之。

translations.literal: Guard and Vanguard Cavalry camps held mounted archery examinations three times a year; Vanguard Guard camps held mounted archery competitions once every three years—inner ministers, banner commanders-in-chief, and others personally supervised.
translations.idiomatic: Guard and Vanguard Cavalry camps held mounted archery examinations three times a year; Vanguard Guard camps held mounted archery competitions once every three years, with inner ministers, banner commanders-in-chief, and others personally supervising.

sentences.zh: 至直省講武，則以督、撫、提、鎮為閫帥，歲季秋霜降日，校閱演武場。

translations.literal: As for martial training in the provinces directly under the capital, governors-general, governors, provincial commanders, and regional commanders served as army commanders; each year on the day of frost descent in late autumn, reviews were held at drill grounds.
translations.idiomatic: As for martial training in the provinces, governors-general, governors, provincial commanders, and regional commanders served as army commanders; each year on the day of frost descent in late autumn, reviews were held at drill grounds.

sentences.zh: 先期立軍幕，屆日黎明，將士擐甲列陣，中建大纛，閫帥率將士行禮。

translations.literal: In advance, military awnings were erected. On the appointed day at dawn, officers and soldiers donned armor and formed battle lines; a great banner was raised in the center; the army commander led officers and soldiers in performing the rites.
translations.idiomatic: In advance, military awnings were erected. On the appointed day at dawn, officers and soldiers donned armor and formed battle lines; a great banner was raised in the center, and the army commander led officers and soldiers in performing the rites.

sentences.zh: 軍門鼓吹，節鉞前導，遍閱行陣，還登將台。

translations.literal: At the camp gate drums and pipes sounded; ceremonial axes led the way; he reviewed the battle lines throughout and then returned to ascend the general's platform.
translations.idiomatic: At the camp gate drums and pipes sounded; ceremonial axes led the way; he reviewed the battle lines throughout and then returned to ascend the general's platform.

sentences.zh: 升帳，中軍上行陣圖式，請令合操。

translations.literal: Ascending to the tent, the headquarters presented battle formation diagrams and requested orders for joint drill.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending to the tent, the headquarters presented battle formation diagrams and requested orders for joint drill.

sentences.zh: 遂麾旗，聲砲三、鳴角、擊鼓。

translations.literal: Then he waved the standard; three cannon sounded, horns blared, and drums were struck.
translations.idiomatic: Then he waved the standard; three cannon sounded, horns blared, and drums were struck.

sentences.zh: 軍中聞鼓聲前進，鳴金則止。

translations.literal: Throughout the army, upon hearing the drum they advanced; upon gongs sounding they halted.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the army, upon hearing the drum they advanced; upon gongs sounding they halted.

sentences.zh: 行陣發槍如京營制。

translations.literal: Battle lines discharged muskets according to capital garrison regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Battle lines discharged muskets according to capital garrison regulations.

sentences.zh: 閱畢，試材官將士騎射，申明賞罰，犒勞軍士。

translations.literal: When the review was finished, selected officers and soldiers were tested in mounted archery; rewards and punishments were declared; soldiers were rewarded and comforted.
translations.idiomatic: When the review was finished, selected officers and soldiers were tested in mounted archery; rewards and punishments were declared, and the soldiers were rewarded and comforted.

sentences.zh: 漕河訓練同八旗。

translations.literal: Grand Canal training followed the Eight Banners.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Canal training followed the Eight Banners.

sentences.zh: 水師操防，出洋信候，各省不同。

translations.literal: Naval drill and defense: the timing for putting out to sea varied by province.
translations.idiomatic: Naval drill and defense: the timing for putting out to sea varied by province.

sentences.zh: 歲春、秋季月或夏季，遇潮平風正，則乘戰艦列陣，張颿馭風，鳴角聲砲，具如軍律。

translations.literal: Each year in the second months of spring and autumn, or in summer, when the tide was calm and winds favorable, they boarded warships, formed battle lines, set sails to catch the wind, and sounded horns and cannon—all fully according to military regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Each year in the second months of spring and autumn, or in summer, when the tide was calm and winds favorable, they boarded warships, formed battle lines, set sails to catch the wind, and sounded horns and cannon—all fully according to military regulations.

sentences.zh: 綠營水師同。

translations.literal: Green Standard naval forces followed the same practice.
translations.idiomatic: Green Standard naval forces followed the same practice.

sentences.zh: 秋獮清自太祖奮跡東陲，率臣下講武校獵習兵，太宗踵行之。

translations.literal: Autumn Hunt: From the time the Taizu raised his banner on the eastern frontier, he led his ministers in martial training, reviewing hunts to drill troops; the Taizong followed and continued this practice.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn Hunt: From the time the Taizu raised his banner on the eastern frontier, he led his ministers in martial training and hunting drills to keep troops in practice; the Taizong followed and continued this practice.

sentences.zh: 世祖統一區夏，數幸南苑，令禁旅行圍，始立大狩扈從例。

translations.literal: The Shizu unified the realm; he frequently visited the Southern Park and ordered prohibition of hunting encampments in the capital region, establishing for the first time the protocol for attendants on the great autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: The Shizu unified the realm; he frequently visited the Southern Park and ordered that hunting encampments be forbidden in the capital region, establishing for the first time the protocol for attendants on the great autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 康熙初元，定車駕行圍駐所置護軍統領、營總各一人，率將校先往度地勢，武備院設行營，建帳殿。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi, it was established that at each site where the imperial carriage hunting encampment halted, one Guard commander-in-chief and one camp chief would be appointed; they led officers in advance to survey the terrain; the Armory set up the traveling camp and erected the canopy hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kangxi, it was established that at each site where the imperial carriage hunting encampment halted, one Guard commander-in-chief and one camp chief would be appointed; they led officers in advance to survey the terrain, while the Armory set up the traveling camp and erected the canopy hall.

sentences.zh: 繚以黃髹木城，立旌門，覆以黃幕。

translations.literal: It was surrounded by a yellow-lacquered wooden palisade, banner gates were erected, and it was roofed with yellow awnings.
translations.idiomatic: It was surrounded by a yellow-lacquered wooden palisade, banner gates were erected, and it was roofed with yellow awnings.

sentences.zh: 其外為網城，宿衛屯置，不越其所。

translations.literal: Outside this was the net enclosure; night guard posts were stationed and none crossed beyond their assigned positions.
translations.idiomatic: Outside this was the net enclosure; night guard posts were stationed, and none crossed beyond their assigned positions.

sentences.zh: 十年，罷木城，改黃幔。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the wooden palisade was abolished and replaced with yellow curtains.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the wooden palisade was abolished and replaced with yellow curtains.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十年，幸塞外，獵南山。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Kangxi, he visited beyond the passes and hunted on the Southern Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of Kangxi, he visited beyond the passes and hunted on the Southern Mountains.

sentences.zh: 尋出山海關，次烏拉，皆御弓矢校獵。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he passed out through Shanhaiguan and halted at Wula—all occasions of imperial bow and arrow hunting drills.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he passed out through Shanhaiguan and halted at Wula—all occasions of imperial bow-and-arrow hunting drills.

sentences.zh: 越二年六月，幸古北口外行圍，木蘭蒐獵始此。

translations.literal: Two years later, in the sixth month, he visited the hunting encampment beyond Gubeikou—this was the beginning of the Mulan battue hunt.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later, in the sixth month, he visited the hunting encampment beyond Gubeikou—this was the beginning of the Mulan battue hunt.

sentences.zh: 木蘭在承德府北四百里，屬翁牛特。

translations.literal: Mulan lay four hundred li north of Chengde Prefecture and belonged to the Ulot Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: Mulan lay four hundred li north of Chengde Prefecture and belonged to the Ulot Mongols.

sentences.zh: 先是籓王進獻為蒐獵所，周千三百餘里，林木蔥鬱，水草茂，群獸聚以孳畜焉。

translations.literal: Previously banner princes had presented it as a battue ground; it extended over more than thirteen hundred li in circumference, its forests lush and dense, its grass and water abundant, with herds of beasts gathered to breed there.
translations.idiomatic: Previously banner princes had presented it as a battue ground; it extended over more than thirteen hundred li in circumference, its forests lush and dense, its grass and water abundant, with herds of beasts gathered there to breed.

sentences.zh: 至是舉行秋獮典，間有冬令再出者。

translations.literal: At this point the autumn hunt ceremony was instituted; occasionally there were second outings in winter.
translations.idiomatic: At this point the autumn hunt ceremony was instituted; occasionally there were second outings in winter.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，設虎槍營，分隸上三旗，置總統、總領。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year the Tiger Spear camp was established, divided among and attached to the Upper Three Banners, with a commander-in-chief and chief officers appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year the Tiger Spear camp was established, divided among and attached to the Upper Three Banners, with a commander-in-chief and chief officers appointed.

sentences.zh: 大狩行田，遇有猛獸，列槍以從。

translations.literal: On the great hunt's field excursions, when fierce beasts were encountered, spearmen were arrayed to follow.
translations.idiomatic: On the great hunt's field excursions, when fierce beasts were encountered, spearmen were arrayed to follow.

sentences.zh: 並命各省駐防兵歲番獵以為常。

translations.literal: It was also ordered that garrison troops in each province hunt in annual rotation as regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: It was also ordered that garrison troops in each province hunt in annual rotation as regular practice.

sentences.zh: 六十一年，復幸塞外行圍，賞蒙古王公等衣物，定為恆制。

translations.literal: In the sixty-first year he again visited the hunting encampment beyond the passes, rewarded Mongol princes and nobles with garments, and established this as permanent regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixty-first year he again visited the hunting encampment beyond the passes, rewarded Mongol princes and nobles with garments, and established this as permanent regulation.

sentences.zh: 雍正八年，令八旗人習步圍，旗各行圍二三次。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yongzheng, Banner people were ordered to practice foot hunts; each banner conducted hunting encampments two or three times.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Yongzheng, Banner people were ordered to practice foot hunts; each banner conducted hunting encampments two or three times.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初元，置綜理行營王公大臣一人，凡啟行、校獵、駐蹕、守衛諸事皆屬之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, one prince or grand minister to oversee the traveling camp was appointed; all matters of setting out, hunting drill, halting the imperial procession, and guarding were under his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qianlong, one prince or grand minister to oversee the traveling camp was appointed; all matters of setting out, hunting drill, halting the imperial procession, and guarding were under his jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 六年，御史叢洞奏請暫停行圍。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Censor Cong Dong memorialized requesting a temporary suspension of hunting encampments.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Censor Cong Dong memorialized requesting a temporary suspension of hunting encampments.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「古者蒐苗獮狩，因田獵講武事。

translations.literal: He instructed: "In antiquity the spring hunt, summer hunt, autumn hunt, and winter hunt—through field hunting military matters were taught.
translations.idiomatic: He instructed: "In antiquity the spring hunt, summer hunt, autumn hunt, and winter hunt—through field hunting military matters were taught.

sentences.zh: 皇祖行圍，既裨戎伍，復舉政綱。

translations.literal: The imperial grandfather's hunting encampments both benefited the army and also upheld the reins of government.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial grandfather's hunting encampments both benefited the army and also upheld the reins of government.

sentences.zh: 至按歷蒙籓，曲加恩意，尤為懷遠宏略。

translations.literal: In touring among the Mongol banners and extending grace in every particular, this was especially a grand strategy of winning over distant peoples.
translations.idiomatic: In touring among the Mongol banners and extending grace in every particular, this was especially a grand strategy of winning over distant peoples.

sentences.zh: 且時方用兵，數有徵發，行圍偶輟，旋即興舉。

translations.literal: Moreover, when military campaigns were underway and levies were repeatedly issued, hunting encampments might occasionally be suspended but were soon resumed.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when military campaigns were underway and levies were repeatedly issued, hunting encampments might occasionally be suspended but were soon resumed.

sentences.zh: 況今承平日久，人習宴安，弓馬漸不如舊，豈可不加振厲？

translations.literal: Now moreover, after long years of peace, people have grown accustomed to ease and comfort, and bowmanship and horsemanship gradually fall short of former days—how can we fail to rouse and strengthen them?
translations.idiomatic: Now moreover, after long years of peace, people have grown accustomed to ease and comfort, and bowmanship and horsemanship gradually fall short of former days—how can we fail to rouse and strengthen them?

sentences.zh: 是秋木蘭行圍，所過州縣，寬免額賦十之三，永為例。」

translations.literal: This autumn at the Mulan hunting encampment, in all prefectures and counties passed through, one-third of assessed taxes shall be remitted, permanently established as precedent."
translations.idiomatic: This autumn at the Mulan hunting encampment, in all prefectures and counties passed through, one-third of assessed taxes shall be remitted, permanently established as precedent."

sentences.zh: 圍場凡六十餘所，每歲大獮，或十八九圍，或二十圍，逾年一易。

translations.literal: The hunting grounds numbered more than sixty in all; each year during the great autumn hunt, sometimes eighteen or nineteen enclosures were conducted, sometimes twenty—changing every other year.
translations.idiomatic: The hunting grounds numbered more than sixty in all; each year during the great autumn hunt, sometimes eighteen or nineteen enclosures were conducted, sometimes twenty—changing every other year.

sentences.zh: 設圍所在，必豫戒期，首某所，逕某所，訖某所收圍，並編定其處。

translations.literal: Wherever an enclosure was to be set, dates were announced in advance: starting at such-and-such a place, passing through such-and-such a place, ending at such-and-such a place to close the enclosure—all locations fixed in the schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever an enclosure was to be set, dates were announced in advance: starting at such-and-such a place, passing through such-and-such a place, ending at such-and-such a place to close the enclosure—all locations fixed in the schedule.

sentences.zh: 屆日官兵赴場布列，祗俟御蹕臨圍。

translations.literal: On the appointed day officers and soldiers proceeded to the grounds to deploy, awaiting only the imperial procession's arrival at the enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the appointed day officers and soldiers proceeded to the grounds to deploy, awaiting only the imperial procession's arrival at the enclosure.

sentences.zh: 自放圍處作重圍，令虎槍營士卒及諸部射生手專射自圍內逸出諸獸。

translations.literal: From the point where the enclosure was opened a double ring was formed; Tiger Spear camp soldiers and marksmen from various tribes were ordered to shoot exclusively at beasts escaping from within the enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: From the point where the enclosure was opened a double ring was formed; Tiger Spear camp soldiers and marksmen from various tribes were ordered to shoot exclusively at beasts escaping from within the enclosure.

sentences.zh: 高宗每行獵，自舊籓四十九旗暨喀爾喀、青海諸部分班從圍，綏輯備至。

translations.literal: Whenever the Gaozong went hunting, the old banner forty-nine banners together with Khalkha, Qinghai, and other tribes took turns following the enclosure, with every care taken to keep them at ease and in good order.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the Gaozong went hunting, the old banner forty-nine banners together with Khalkha, Qinghai, and other tribes took turns following the enclosure, with every care taken to keep them at ease and in good order.

sentences.zh: 洎平西域，遠籓如左右哈薩克，東西布魯特，安集延，布哈爾，朝謁踵集，唯恐後時。

translations.literal: When the Western Regions were pacified, distant banner peoples such as the Left and Right Kazakhs, the Eastern and Western Kyrgyz, Andijan, and Bukhara came in audience one after another, all fearing to arrive too late.
translations.idiomatic: When the Western Regions were pacified, distant banner peoples such as the Left and Right Kazakhs, the Eastern and Western Kyrgyz, Andijan, and Bukhara came in audience one after another, all fearing to arrive too late.

sentences.zh: 土爾扈特亦皆挈部眾越數萬里來庭。

translations.literal: The Torghut too all brought their tribesmen across tens of thousands of li to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: The Torghut too all brought their tribesmen across tens of thousands of li to come to court.

sentences.zh: 帝嘗御布固圖昌阿撫慰之，旋賜名曰「伊綿」，國語會極歸極也。

translations.literal: The emperor once received them at Bugutu Chang'a to console them, and soon bestowed the name "Yimian"—in the national language, "convergence to the ultimate and return to the ultimate."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once received them at Bugutu Chang'a to console them, and soon bestowed the name "Yimian"—in the Manchu language, "convergence to the ultimate and return to the ultimate."

sentences.zh: 二十年，更定網城植連帳百七十五，設旌門三，分樹軍纛曰金龍。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, the net enclosure was revised: one hundred seventy-five connected tents were erected, three banner gates were set up, and military banners distributed and planted were called Golden Dragon.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, the net enclosure was revised: one hundred seventy-five connected tents were erected, three banner gates were set up, and military banners distributed and planted were called Golden Dragon.

sentences.zh: 去網城連帳外十許丈為外城，植連帳二百五十四，設旌門四，分樹軍纛曰飛虎。

translations.literal: About ten-odd zhang beyond the net enclosure's connected tents was the outer enclosure; two hundred fifty-four connected tents were erected, four banner gates were set up, and military banners distributed and planted were called Flying Tiger.
translations.idiomatic: About ten-odd zhang beyond the net enclosure's connected tents was the outer enclosure; two hundred fifty-four connected tents were erected, four banner gates were set up, and military banners distributed and planted were called Flying Tiger.

sentences.zh: 去外連帳六十丈，周圍警蹕，立帳房四十，各建旗幟，八旗護軍專司之。

translations.literal: Sixty zhang from the outer connected tents, guards cleared the perimeter; forty tent quarters were erected, each flying banners and standards, with Eight Banner guard troops exclusively responsible.
translations.idiomatic: Sixty zhang from the outer connected tents, guards cleared the perimeter; forty tent quarters were erected, each flying banners and standards, with Eight Banner guard troops exclusively responsible.

sentences.zh: 其規制詳密如此。

translations.literal: Its regulations were detailed and thorough to this degree.
translations.idiomatic: Its regulations were detailed and thorough to this degree.

sentences.zh: 凡秋獮，先期各駐防長官選材官赴京肄習。

translations.literal: For every autumn hunt, in advance the garrison commanders in each province selected skilled officers to proceed to the capital for training.
translations.idiomatic: For every autumn hunt, in advance the garrison commanders in each province selected skilled officers to proceed to the capital for training.

sentences.zh: 年例，蒙籓選千二百五十人為虞卒，謂之「圍牆」，以供合圍役。

translations.literal: By annual regulation, Mongol banners selected twelve hundred fifty men as beaters, called "enclosure walls," to serve in closing the hunt.
translations.idiomatic: By annual regulation, Mongol banners selected twelve hundred fifty men as beaters, called "enclosure walls," to serve in closing the hunt.

sentences.zh: 屆期，帝戎服乘騎出宮，扈引如巡幸儀。

translations.literal: When the day arrived, the emperor in military dress mounted and rode out of the palace, escorted as in imperial tour rites.
translations.idiomatic: When the day arrived, the emperor in military dress mounted and rode out of the palace, escorted according to the rites for an imperial tour.

sentences.zh: 既駐行營，禁兵士踐禾稼、擾吏民，訶止夜行，違者論如律。

translations.literal: Once encamped in the field camp, soldiers were forbidden to trample grain or disturb officials and commoners; night travel was forbidden by command, and violators were punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Once the field camp was established, soldiers were forbidden to trample grain or disturb officials and commoners; night travel was forbidden by command, and violators were punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 統圍大臣蒞場所，按旗整隊，中建黃纛為中軍，兩翼斜行建紅、白二纛為表，兩翼末國語曰烏圖哩，各建藍纛為表，皆受中軍節度。

translations.literal: The grand coordinator of the hunt arrived at the ground, arrayed ranks by banner; in the center a yellow standard was erected as the central army; on the two wings oblique lines raised red and white standards as markers; at the wing ends, called uturi in the national language, blue standards were raised as markers—all subject to the central army's command.
translations.idiomatic: The grand coordinator of the hunt arrived at the ground and arrayed ranks by banner; in the center a yellow standard marked the central army; on the two wings oblique lines raised red and white standards as markers; at the wing ends, called uturi in the national language, blue standards were raised as markers—all subject to the central army's command.

sentences.zh: 管圍大臣以王公大臣領之，蒙古王、公、台吉為副。

translations.literal: The hunt-area ministers were led by imperial princes and grand ministers, with Mongol princes, dukes, and taiji as deputies.
translations.idiomatic: The hunt-area ministers were led by imperial princes and grand ministers, with Mongol princes, dukes, and taiji as deputies.

sentences.zh: 兩烏圖哩則各以巴圖魯侍衛三人率領馳行，蟬聯環匝，自遠而近。

translations.literal: The two uturi were each led in gallop by three baturu guards, linking in succession in a ring from far to near.
translations.idiomatic: The two uturi were each led in gallop by three baturu guards, linking in succession in a ring that closed from far to near.

sentences.zh: 蓋圍制有二，馳入山林，圍而不合曰行圍，國語曰阿達密。

translations.literal: The hunt formation had two types: galloping into forests and hills with an enclosure not closed was called a moving hunt, adami in the national language.
translations.idiomatic: The hunt formation had two types: galloping into forests and hills without closing the ring was called a moving hunt, adami in the national language.

sentences.zh: 合圍者，則於五鼓前，管圍大臣率從獵各士旅往視山川大小遠近，紆道出場外，或三五十里，或七八十里，齊至看城，是為合圍，國語曰烏圖哩阿察密。

translations.literal: For a closed ring hunt, before the fifth watch the hunt-area ministers led the various hunting companies to survey the size and distance of mountains and rivers, taking circuitous routes outside the hunting ground for thirty or fifty li, or seventy or eighty li, all assembling at the viewing camp—this was the closed ring hunt, uturi achami in the national language.
translations.idiomatic: For a closed-ring hunt, before the fifth watch the hunt-area ministers led the various hunting companies to survey the terrain, taking circuitous routes outside the hunting ground for thirty or fifty li, or seventy or eighty li, all assembling at the viewing camp—this was the closed-ring hunt, uturi achami in the national language.

sentences.zh: 看城者，即黃幔城也。

translations.literal: The viewing camp was the yellow curtain camp.
translations.idiomatic: The viewing camp was the yellow curtain camp.

sentences.zh: 圍既合，烏圖哩處虞卒脫帽以鞭擎之，高聲傳呼「瑪爾噶」，蒙語謂帽也。

translations.literal: When the ring was closed, at the uturi positions the hunt attendants removed their hats and held them aloft on whips, shouting loudly "Margag"—Mongol for hat.
translations.idiomatic: When the ring was closed, at the uturi positions the hunt attendants removed their hats and held them aloft on whips, shouting loudly "Margag"—Mongol for hat.

sentences.zh: 聲傳遞至中軍，凡三次，中軍知圍合，乃擁纛徐行。

translations.literal: The call was relayed to the central army three times in all; knowing the ring was closed, the central army then bore the standards forward slowly.
translations.idiomatic: The call was relayed to the central army three times in all; knowing the ring was closed, the central army then bore the standards forward slowly.

sentences.zh: 日出前，帝自行營乘騎先至看城少憩，俟藍纛至，駕出，御櫜鞬，入中軍周覽圍內形勢。

translations.literal: Before sunrise the emperor rode from the field camp first to the viewing camp for a brief rest; when the blue standards arrived he set out, took up bow and quiver, and entered the central army to survey the situation within the ring.
translations.idiomatic: Before sunrise the emperor rode from the field camp first to the viewing camp for a brief rest; when the blue standards arrived he set out, took up bow and quiver, and entered the central army to survey the situation within the ring.

sentences.zh: 凡疾徐進止，口敕指麾。

translations.literal: All quickening, slowing, advancing, and halting were directed by verbal command.
translations.idiomatic: All quickening, slowing, advancing, and halting were directed by verbal command.

sentences.zh: 獸突圍，發矢殪之。

translations.literal: If beasts broke the ring, arrows were loosed to kill them.
translations.idiomatic: If beasts broke through the ring, he loosed arrows to kill them.

sentences.zh: 御前大臣、侍衛皆射其逸圍外者，從官追射。

translations.literal: Ministers before the throne and guards all shot those that escaped outside the ring; attending officials pursued and shot.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers before the throne and guards all shot those that escaped outside the ring, and attending officials pursued and shot.

sentences.zh: 或遇猛獸，虎槍官兵從之。

translations.literal: If fierce beasts were encountered, tiger-gun troops and officers followed.
translations.idiomatic: If fierce beasts were encountered, tiger-gun troops and officers followed.

sentences.zh: 或值場內獸過多，則開一面使逸，仍禁圍外諸人逐射。

translations.literal: If too many beasts were within the ground, one side was opened to let them escape, while those outside the ring were still forbidden to pursue and shoot.
translations.idiomatic: If too many beasts were within the ground, one side was opened to let them escape, while those outside the ring were still forbidden to pursue and shoot.

sentences.zh: 獲獸已，比其類以獻。

translations.literal: When beasts were taken, they were presented grouped by kind.
translations.idiomatic: When beasts were taken, they were presented grouped by kind.

sentences.zh: 駕還行宮，謂之散圍。

translations.literal: The imperial procession returned to the traveling palace—this was called dispersing the ring.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial procession returned to the traveling palace—this was called dispersing the ring.

sentences.zh: 頒所獲於扈從者，大獮禮成，宴賚有差。

translations.literal: The catch was distributed to those in attendance; when the great battue rites were completed, banquets and rewards were granted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The catch was distributed to those in attendance; when the great battue rites were completed, banquets and rewards were granted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 哨鹿者，凡鹿始鳴，恆在白露後，效其聲呼之，可引至。

translations.literal: Stalking deer by call: whenever deer first begin to call, it is always after White Dew; imitating their sound summons them and they can be led in.
translations.idiomatic: Stalking deer by call: whenever deer first begin to call, it is always after White Dew; imitating their sound summons them and they can be led in.

sentences.zh: 厥制與常日不同。

translations.literal: Its procedure differed from ordinary days.
translations.idiomatic: Its procedure differed from ordinary days.

sentences.zh: 侍衛等分隊為三，約出營十餘里，俟旨停第三隊。

translations.literal: Guards and others were divided into three teams; about ten-odd li out from camp, on awaiting the order the third team halted.
translations.idiomatic: Guards and others were divided into three teams; about ten-odd li out from camp, on awaiting the order the third team halted.

sentences.zh: 又四五里，停第二隊。

translations.literal: Another four or five li on, the second team halted.
translations.idiomatic: Another four or five li on, the second team halted.

sentences.zh: 又二三里，將至哨鹿所，則停第一隊。

translations.literal: Another two or three li, as they were about to reach the deer-stalking place, the first team halted.
translations.idiomatic: Another two or three li on, as they were about to reach the deer-stalking place, the first team halted.

sentences.zh: 時扈從諸臣止十餘騎而已。

translations.literal: At that time the attending ministers numbered only ten-odd riders.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the attending ministers numbered only ten-odd riders.

sentences.zh: 帝命槍獲鹿，群引領俟旨，而三隊以次至御前，高宗蒐獵木蘭時，親御名駿，命侍衛等導入深山中。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the gunners to take deer; the group craned their necks awaiting the order, and the three teams in succession came before the throne; when the Gaozong hunted at Mulan he personally rode a famous steed and ordered guards and others to guide him deep into the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the gunners to take deer; the group craned their necks awaiting the order, and the three teams in succession came before the throne; when the Gaozong hunted at Mulan he personally rode a famous steed and ordered guards and others to guide him deep into the mountains.

sentences.zh: 望見鹿群，命一侍衛舉假鹿頭作呦呦聲，引牝鹿至，亟發矢殪之，取其血以飲。

translations.literal: Seeing a herd of deer, he ordered one guard to raise a false deer head and make a bleating sound to lure a doe; he quickly loosed an arrow and killed it, and took its blood to drink.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing a herd of deer, he ordered one guard to raise a false deer head and make a bleating sound to lure a doe; he quickly loosed an arrow and killed it, and took its blood to drink.

sentences.zh: 不唯益壯，亦以習勞也。

translations.literal: This not only increased vigor but also served to accustom oneself to labor.
translations.idiomatic: This not only increased vigor but also served to accustom oneself to labor.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶時秋獮仿此。

translations.literal: In the Jiaqing period the autumn hunt followed this model.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiaqing period the autumn hunt followed this model.

sentences.zh: 日食救護順治元年，定制，遇日食，京朝文武百官俱赴禮部救護。

translations.literal: Solar eclipse rescue rites: In the first year of Shunzhi regulations were fixed; when a solar eclipse occurred, all civil and military officials of the capital court went to the Ministry of Rites for rescue rites.
translations.idiomatic: Solar Eclipse Rescue Rites: In the first year of Shunzhi regulations were fixed; when a solar eclipse occurred, all civil and military officials of the capital court went to the Ministry of Rites for rescue rites.

sentences.zh: 康熙十四年，改由欽天監推算時刻分秒，禮部會同驗准，行知各省官司。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi it was changed so that the Directorate of Astronomy calculated the hours, minutes, and seconds; the Ministry of Rites jointly verified and approved, and notified the offices of each province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi it was changed so that the Directorate of Astronomy calculated the hours, minutes, and seconds; the Ministry of Rites jointly verified and approved, and notified the offices of each province.

sentences.zh: 其儀，凡遇日食，八旗滿、蒙、漢軍都統、副都統率屬在所部警備，行救護禮。

translations.literal: The ritual: whenever a solar eclipse occurred, the commandants and vice-commandants of the Eight Banners' Manchu, Mongol, and Han armies led their subordinates in guard and alert within their jurisdictions and performed the rescue rites.
translations.idiomatic: For the ritual: whenever a solar eclipse occurred, the commandants and vice-commandants of the Eight Banners' Manchu, Mongol, and Han armies led their subordinates in guard and alert within their jurisdictions and performed the rescue rites.

sentences.zh: 順天府則飭役赴部潔淨堂署，內外設香案，露台上爐檠具，後布百官拜席。

translations.literal: The Shuntian prefecture ordered laborers to the Ministry's Hall of Purification; incense tables were set inside and outside, censers and stands on the terrace, and behind them the officials' kneeling mats were spread.
translations.idiomatic: The Shuntian prefecture ordered laborers to the Ministry's Hall of Purification; incense tables were set inside and outside, censers and stands on the terrace, and behind them the officials' kneeling mats were spread.

sentences.zh: 鑾儀衛官陳金鼓儀門兩旁，樂部署史奉鼓俟台下，俱鄉日。

translations.literal: Imperial guard officers arrayed gold drums on both sides of the ceremonial gate; music-office clerks bore drums and waited below the terrace, all facing the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial guard officers arrayed gold drums on both sides of the ceremonial gate; music-office clerks bore drums and waited below the terrace, all facing the sun.

sentences.zh: 欽天監官報日初虧，鳴贊贊「齊班」。

translations.literal: When the Directorate of Astronomy officer announced the sun's first eclipse, the intoner intoned "Align the ranks."
translations.idiomatic: When the Directorate of Astronomy officer announced the sun's first eclipse, the intoner intoned "Align the ranks."

sentences.zh: 百官素服，分五列，每班以禮部長官一人領之。

translations.literal: Officials in plain dress were divided into five columns, each rank led by one senior official of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Officials in plain dress were divided into five columns, each rank led by one senior official of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 贊「進」，贊「跪，叩，興」。

translations.literal: He intoned "Advance," intoned "Kneel, prostrate, rise."
translations.idiomatic: He intoned "Advance," then "Kneel, prostrate, rise."

sentences.zh: 樂作，俱三跪九叩，興。

translations.literal: Music was performed; all performed three kneelings and nine prostrations and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Music was performed; all performed three kneelings and nine prostrations and rose.

sentences.zh: 班首詣案前三上香，復位。

translations.literal: The rank leader went to the table and offered incense three times, then returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: The rank leader went to the table and offered incense three times, then returned to position.

sentences.zh: 贊「跪」，則皆跪。

translations.literal: He intoned "Kneel," and all knelt.
translations.idiomatic: He intoned "Kneel," and all knelt.

sentences.zh: 贊「伐鼓」，署史奉鼓進，跪左旁，班首擊鼓三聲，金鼓齊鳴，更番上香，祗跪候覆圓。

translations.literal: He intoned "Beat the drums"; a clerk bore the drum forward and knelt at the left; the rank leader struck the drum three times; gold and battle drums sounded together; incense was offered in rotation; all knelt reverently awaiting the sun's restoration.
translations.idiomatic: He intoned "Beat the drums"; a clerk bore the drum forward and knelt at the left; the rank leader struck the drum three times; gold and battle drums sounded together; incense was offered in rotation; all knelt reverently awaiting the sun's restoration.

sentences.zh: 鼓止，百官易吉服，行禮如初。

translations.literal: When the drums ceased, officials changed into auspicious dress and performed rites as at first.
translations.idiomatic: When the drums ceased, officials changed into auspicious dress and performed rites as at first.

sentences.zh: 畢，俱退。

translations.literal: When finished, all withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, all withdrew.

sentences.zh: 是日禮部祠祭司官、欽天監博士各二人，赴觀象台測驗。

translations.literal: That day two sacrificial officials of the Ministry of Rites and two doctors of the Directorate of Astronomy went to the Observatory to test and verify.
translations.idiomatic: That day two sacrificial officials of the Ministry of Rites and two doctors of the Directorate of Astronomy went to the Observatory to test and verify.

sentences.zh: 鄉日設香案，初虧復圓，行禮如儀。

translations.literal: Facing the sun an incense table was set; at first eclipse and restoration to fullness, rites were performed according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Facing the sun an incense table was set; at first eclipse and restoration to fullness, rites were performed according to ritual.

sentences.zh: 若月食，則在中軍都督府救護，尋改太常寺，如救日儀。

translations.literal: For lunar eclipses, rescue was performed at the Central Military Commission; later it was changed to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, as for solar eclipse rites.
translations.idiomatic: For lunar eclipses, rescue was performed at the Central Military Commission; later it was changed to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, following the same rites as for a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 直省遇日、月食，各按欽天監推定時刻分秒，隨地救護。

translations.literal: In the provinces when solar or lunar eclipses occurred, each followed the Directorate of Astronomy's calculated hours, minutes, and seconds and performed rescue rites locally.
translations.idiomatic: In the provinces when solar or lunar eclipses occurred, each followed the Directorate of Astronomy's calculated hours, minutes, and seconds and performed rescue rites locally.

sentences.zh: 省會行之督、撫署，府、廳、州、縣行之各公署，並以教職糾儀，學弟子員贊引，陰陽官報時。

translations.literal: At provincial capitals it was performed at the governor-general's or governor's yamen; at prefectures, sub-prefectures, departments, and counties at each public office; education officials corrected ritual, academy students intoned and led, and yin-yang officials announced the time.
translations.idiomatic: At provincial capitals it was performed at the governor-general's or governor's yamen; at prefectures, sub-prefectures, departments, and counties at each public office; education officials corrected ritual, academy students intoned and led, and yin-yang officials announced the time.

sentences.zh: 至領班行禮，則以督撫及正官一人主之。

translations.literal: As for leading the ranks in performing rites, the governor-general or governor together with one chief official presided.
translations.idiomatic: As for leading the ranks in performing rites, the governor-general or governor together with one chief official presided.

sentences.zh: 上香、伐鼓、祗跪，與京師救護同。

translations.literal: Offering incense, beating drums, and kneeling reverently were the same as capital rescue rites.
translations.idiomatic: Offering incense, beating drums, and kneeling reverently were the same as the capital rescue rites.
